{{Quote|I did this to a xeno on Raskane IV. He squirmed for three days until he died. How long do you reckon ''you'll'' last?|Matt Talon|<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>}}
'''Raskane IV''' was an [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Sepan sector/Legends|Sepan sector]]. [[Politics/Legends|Political]] tensions nearly led to a civil war on the planet around [[3643 BBY]], but the situation was defused by an individual affiliated with one of the sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agent [[Matt Talon]] once claimed that he had caused the [[Torture/Legends|agony]] and [[Death/Legends|death]] of an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] on Raskane IV.

==Description==
Raskane IV<ref name="GG9" /> was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. It occupied the fourth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position<ref name="Reunification" /> in the [[Raskane system/Legends|Raskane system]], a part of the [[Sepan sector/Legends|Sepan sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Reunification" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> tensions between [[Politics/Legends|political]] factions on Raskane IV nearly led to a civil war. An individual affiliated with one of the sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] dispatched a companion to the planet in order to determine the faction that would be the easiest to manipulate in the future. The companion was also tasked with ensuring the success of that party once it was identified. Eventually, the companion tactfully eased the political tensions on Raskane IV and directed the resentment of the planet's political leaders toward the most vocal proponents of the civil war.<ref name="Reunification" />
{{Endgame}}

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agent [[Matt Talon]], who worked undercover as a [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] and had a violent personality and past, attempted to intimidate an individual during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. According to Talon's claims, he had once inflicted a trauma upon an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] on Raskane IV, with the victim [[Death/Legends|dying]] after three [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of [[Torture/Legends|agony]].<ref name="GG9" />

==Behind the scenes==
Raskane IV was first mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'', a [[1993]] sourcebook written by [[Simon Smith]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG9" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Raskane [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Raskane IV, in grid square P-13.<ref name="TEA" /> ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[BioWare]], introduced the planet's alternate name "Raskane Four."<ref name="Reunification" />
